purpose: Fault-injection probe for reconstruction across scheduled-Chat invocations without process/conversation memory.

operation_semantics.reconstruction_rule: On the later invocation, fetch current authoritative HEAD/root first. If op_id is already applied, DONE_NOOP. Otherwise derive before/after values from that current root, not from this file's observed base snapshot.

forbidden_shortcut: Do not treat observed_when_planned as current authority on resume and do not use conversation history as the operation source. Discover this pending artifact via role-local durable state/LATEST and start at RECONSTRUCT in phase1_retry_state_machine_v1.json.
creating_invocation_action: Persist only; deliberately do not create operation events/root and do not update TX_HEAD.
resume_success_criteria: later invocation identifies this pending op from role-local durable state
later invocation fetches authoritative HEAD/root before deriving candidate events
publication is CAS-protected and read back
if already applied, retry performs no mutation
artifact is superseded by a completion record rather than edited in place
